vignette: A 45-year-old man has drug-resistant seizures of the type described above. Coronal FLAIR MRI shows a small bright left hippocampus with loss of its internal architecture and a dilated left temporal horn.
explanation: A small hippocampus with increased FLAIR signal, loss of the internal digitations and an enlarged temporal horn is mesial temporal sclerosis, the commonest surgically curable epilepsy; a tumor would expand rather than shrink the hippocampus and herpes would be acute with fever.
